outcome_ar: يغطي المتعلم القرائن الحاسمة قبل إصدار حكم
observable_behavior: Opens expert-flagged critical clues before first accusation; searches are linked to a logged hypothesis
gameplay_task: Crime-scene/room exploration with 8-15 inspectable items, 1-4 flagged critical by expert key
evidence_rule: O1 = share of critical clues opened before first commit (>=0.8 full, 0.5-0.8 partial); O2 = share of inspections following a related hypothesis
scoring: O1: 0/0.5/1; O2: 0-1 continuous; G=0.15 (O1), 0.30 (O2); min dwell time filter to exclude click-through
data_captured: clue_open events with timestamps, dwell time, hypothesis_log, commit timestamp

outcome_ar: يقيّم موثوقية الشاهد بحسب ظروف الإدراك والمصلحة والاتساق
observable_behavior: Rates a witness with poor viewing conditions (distance, light, time) lower than a well-placed one
gameplay_task: Two-witness scene with planted perception flaw; 1-4 reliability rating per testimony
evidence_rule: O3 = |learner rating - expert key| per testimony; success if within 1 point and ordering matches key
scoring: 0/1 per testimony; G=0.25; capped contribution per scene
data_captured: reliability_rating per testimony, time spent on testimony, notes

observable_behavior: Flags the planted contradiction (e.g., camera clock offset vs wall clock; testimony vs access log) without prompting
gameplay_task: Evidence board with a 'contradiction' tag; planted conflict between two sources
evidence_rule: O4 = contradiction tagged between the correct pair before end of case; prompted detection counted with G raised
scoring: 0/1; G=0.05 unprompted, 0.15 after prompt, 0.25 after scaffold
data_captured: evidence_board tags (source pair, timestamp), guidance level at time of tag

outcome_ar: يحدد بدقة هل القرينة تدعم الفرضية أم تضعفها أم لا صلة لها بها
observable_behavior: Creates evidence->hypothesis links whose direction matches expert key; avoids linking red herrings
gameplay_task: Drag clue onto hypothesis card and choose supports/weakens/irrelevant
evidence_rule: O5 = precision and recall of links vs expert key (false links penalised)
scoring: 0-1 continuous -> partial credit to Beta layer; per-link BKT update with G=0.33

outcome_ar: يُبقي أكثر من تفسير معقول مفتوحاً قبل الالتزام
observable_behavior: Logs >=2 plausible hypotheses before first commit
evidence_rule: O6 = count of plausible hypotheses (per expert list) logged before commit

outcome_ar: يستبعد التفسير البديل الرئيسي بدليل محدد
observable_behavior: Rejects the main alternative by citing the specific disconfirming clue
gameplay_task: Final accusation form: 'why not X?' structured field or free text
evidence_rule: O7 = main alternative rejected AND cited clue id in expert disconfirming set
scoring: 0/1; G=0.05; free text routed through extraction then rule scoring
data_captured: structured rejection field or extracted argument JSON, scorer version + confidence

outcome_ar: يعدّل فرضيته أو ثقته عند ظهور دليل معارض
observable_behavior: After late-revealed disconfirming evidence, re-ranks hypotheses or lowers confidence in the correct direction
gameplay_task: Late twist scene (new lab result or record) contradicting the early favourite
evidence_rule: O8 = hypothesis rank change or confidence drop >=15 points within the scene after reveal
scoring: 0/1; G=0.15; no credit if learner had already discarded the favourite
data_captured: hypothesis ranking snapshots, confidence slider before/after reveal

outcome_ar: يميز بين نتيجة «متسقة مع» ونتيجة «تثبت» في الأدلة العلمية
observable_behavior: Chooses 'consistent with, not conclusive' for a common-trait match; considers how common the trait is
gameplay_task: Virtual lab scene with fictional data (e.g., common fibre type) and three interpretations
evidence_rule: O9 = correct interpretation chosen; K-node 'base rate' updated separately
scoring: 0/1; G=0.33; separate knowledge node so knowledge gaps are not read as reasoning failure

outcome_ar: يكتب أو يقول تبريراً يستشهد بالأدلة الحاسمة ويستبعد البديل
observable_behavior: Justification cites >=1 decisive clue and rejects main alternative; scored on argument structure, not style
gameplay_task: Final report: text (MSA or dialect), Arabizi, or voice; optional structured template for 13-15
evidence_rule: O10 rubric 0-3 applied to extracted {claim, cited_evidence_ids, relation, rejected_alternative}
scoring: 0-3 -> partial credit; scorer must pass length/dialect/eloquent-empty audits; low-confidence scores excluded or human-reviewed
data_captured: raw response, extracted argument JSON, scorer model+prompt version, scorer confidence, response length

outcome_ar: تتناسب ثقته المعلنة مع قوة أدلته وصحة أحكامه
observable_behavior: Stated confidence before solution reveal tracks accuracy across cases
gameplay_task: Confidence slider (0-100) at each commit; post-season 'confidence vs accuracy' chart
evidence_rule: O11 = Brier score / calibration gap aggregated over >=5 commits; O12 = premature commit flag
scoring: Reported only cumulatively (>=5 cases); never from a single case
data_captured: confidence values, correctness, commit timing relative to critical clue access

outcome_ar: يخطط لتحقيقه ويراقب تقدمه ويتأمل بعده
observable_behavior: Writes a brief plan (what to check first), uses status overview, completes debrief reflection naming one rule learned
gameplay_task: Case opening 'investigation plan' card; mid-case status overview; end-of-case debrief prompt
evidence_rule: Plan present and followed (overlap of planned vs opened items); debrief names a transferable rule (keyword/structure match + human sampling)
scoring: Formative only - not used in mastery estimate in v0.1
data_captured: plan text/choices, status overview opens, debrief response

outcome_ar: يتحقق من صحة صورة أو خبر رقمي قبل تصديقه
observable_behavior: Leaves the source to check it (lateral reading), checks earliest publication date, separates 'image is real' from 'claim attached is true'
gameplay_task: Digital-misinformation case with simulated reverse image search and fictional sources
evidence_rule: Lateral check before verdict (O1-digital); date conflict tagged (O4); claim/image distinction (O9-digital)
scoring: Same scoring as O1/O4/O9 with G per format
data_captured: simulated search actions, sources opened, verdict, justification

outcome_ar: يطبق المهارة نفسها في قضية من مجال مختلف دون مساعدة
observable_behavior: Shows S2/S3/S5/S6 behaviours in a structurally isomorphic case from a new domain and representation (e.g., environmental data table)
gameplay_task: Transfer probe case: no hints, new domain, new modality; held out of mastery estimation
evidence_rule: Same observables as training cases; compared with learner's training estimates and with control group
scoring: Reported separately as transfer indicator; requires validation study before any claim
data_captured: full case log; no guidance available

outcome_ar: يتذكر قاعدة استدلالية من قضية سابقة ويطبقها بعد فترة
observable_behavior: Applies an earlier rule (e.g., 'consistent with does not prove') in a later case after >=7 days without reminder
gameplay_task: Spaced recall moments woven into later cases (mentor asks 'what did we learn about fibre evidence?')
evidence_rule: Correct retrieval + application within the case; retention observation flags the skill's stability
scoring: 0/1; updates stability parameter (decay model); required for 'secure' status
data_captured: retrieval response, delay since last practice

outcome_ar: يعمل ضمن فريق تحقيق ويناقش الأدلة بحجج
observable_behavior: Contributes evidence-based arguments in team discussion; changes position when shown better evidence
gameplay_task: Team case (3-4 players) with distributed clues and shared board; structured debate step
evidence_rule: Count of evidence-cited contributions; position changes after evidence; individual attribution only for own actions
scoring: Formative/team-level only in v0.1 (individual attribution in teams is a validity risk)
data_captured: chat/board actions per player, role, timestamps
